description: This Kotlin source file contains UI test automation functions for the 'For You' section of the 'Now in Android' app, implementing wait, selection, scrolling, and theme-setting routines used in macrobenchmark tests.

methods.name: forYouWaitForContent
methods.description: Waits for the 'forYou' content to load by checking for the disappearance of the loading wheel and the presence of the topic selection element, with appropriate timeout intervals.

methods.name: forYouSelectTopics
methods.description: Selects multiple topics in the 'forYou' section, optionally rechecking topics if already selected, by interacting with checkable topic items while managing gesture margins.

methods.name: forYouScrollFeedDownUp
methods.description: Performs a fling gesture to scroll down and then back up in the feed list to simulate user scrolling.

methods.name: setAppTheme
methods.description: Sets the app theme to dark or light based on the boolean parameter by clicking on the corresponding option and confirming, then waits for the app bar to be visible.
